title: Among Wolves
description: Two missionaries witness a murder by hired guns and go on the run. They stumble onto the cabin of two retired contract killers who agree to help the women find safety, but only their guns can secure that promise.

title: If... Dog... Rabbit
description: When a criminal is released from prison, he promptly returns to a life of crime with his lawbreaking brother.

title: Eat My Dust!
description: A California sheriff's son and his girlfriend go for a joyride in a stolen stock car.

title: Eat My Dust!
description: A California sheriff's son and his girlfriend go for a joyride in a stolen stock car.

title: Joe Strummer: The Future Is Unwritten
description: Martin Scorsese, Bono, Jim Jarmusch, Flea and others recall the life of Joe Strummer, singer and guitarist for the Clash.

title: Georgia Rule
description: Exasperated with her rebellious daughter (Lindsay Lohan), a woman (Felicity Huffman) sends the teen to Idaho to live with her own stern mother (Jane Fonda).

title: Luv
description: Accompanied by his young nephew (Michael Rainey Jr.), an ex-convict (Common) tries to raise money through a drug deal.

title: Homegrown
description: A go-between (Kelly Lynch) helps California marijuana growers (Billy Bob Thornton, Hank Azaria) take action when their boss is killed.

title: Inland Empire
description: Two actors (Laura Dern, Justin Theroux) star in a remake of a film which was originally unfinished because its leads were murdered.

title: Eyes Without a Face
description: A Paris surgeon (Pierre Brasseur) tries to fix his daughter's (Edith Scob) face with skin from kidnapped women.

title: Dawg
description: In order to inherit $1 million, a heartless womanizer (Denis Leary) must seek forgiveness from his former conquests.

title: Crimson Rivers: Angels of the Apocalypse
description: Three investigators (Jean Reno, Benoît Magimel, Camille Natta) track a cloaked killer who possesses superhuman strength and speed.

title: Down by Law
description: A disc jockey (Tom Waits), a pimp (John Lurie) and an Italian tourist (Roberto Benigni) escape from jail in New Orleans.

title: Glengarry Glen Ross
description: Underhanded real estate salesmen sink to varying levels of deceit in order to sell their dubious properties.

title: Class of 1984
description: A high-school music teacher (Perry King) hunts a hoodlum student (Timothy Van Patten) for attacking his wife (Merrie Lynn Ross).

title: Dragon Fist
description: A kung-fu student avenges the slaying of his master, with help from his master's clan.

title: Night of the Demons
description: Wild teenage girls (Mimi Kinkade, Linnea Quigley) hold a Halloween seance in an old funeral parlor to scare their friends.

title: Last Days in the Desert
description: As he wanders in the desert, Jesus Christ (Ewan McGregor) tangles with Satan (also McGregor) for the souls of a nomad (Ciarán Hinds) and his family.

title: Living in Oblivion
description: A harried director must contend with technical foul-ups and actors' shenanigans on the set of a low-budget film.

title: Midnight Sun
description: A teen who lives with a life-threatening sensitivity to sunlight finds romance with a young man she's admired for years. As their relationship starts to blossom, she desperately tries to hide her condition from her unsuspecting new beau.

title: House
description: A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

title: Nosferatu
description: Vampire Count Orlok expresses interest in a new residence -- and his new real estate agent Hutter's wife.

title: Fitzcarraldo
description: An Irish dreamer (Klaus Kinski) hauls a huge riverboat overland in his quest for opera in the Amazon.

title: Night of the Living Dead
description: A ragtag group of Pennsylvanians barricade themselves in an old farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls that are ravaging the United States.

title: My Sassy Girl
description: A guy (Jesse Bradford) has his life planned out, until he is wooed, groomed and then dumped by an elusive woman (Elisha Cuthbert).

title: Kingslayer
description: Soon to be crowned king of England, Richard the Lionheart has an attempted courtship turn quickly into a race for survival. Ambushed during a romantic encounter, Richard and his stable maid Lea fight for their lives.

title: On Golden Pond
description: An old professor (Henry Fonda) and his wife (Katharine Hepburn) make peace with their daughter (Jane Fonda) in New England.

title: Nightbreed: Director's Cut
description: A young man's quest to end his nightmares leads him to a cemetery where monsters have retreated to escape mankind.

title: K-19: The Widowmaker
description: The commander (Harrison Ford) of a Russian submarine tries to avert a disaster after a nuclear reactor malfunctions.

title: Legionnaire
description: A 1920s playboy returns from a stint in the French Foreign Legion to reclaim his lover, a mobster's mistress.

title: Just Getting Started
description: It's Christmas in the Dessert and an ex-F.B.I. Agent and an ex-mob lawyer in the Witness Protection Program must work together.

title: Lazy Susan
description: Susan is a self-centered woman who lazily skates through life with the grudging support of her increasingly estranged family. Realizing she's middle-aged with no job and no relationship, Susan finally decides to take charge and turn things around.

title: Legacy of Rage
description: Sentenced to prison for a crime he did not commit, a man sets out for revenge after his release from jail.

title: Learning to Drive
description: A literary agent (Patricia Clarkson) whose husband left her and a Sikh driving instructor (Ben Kingsley) on the verge of an arranged marriage find that each has something to learn from the other about starting life anew.

title: Lancaster Skies
description: A solitary Spitfire ace pilot must overcome his past to lead a Lancaster bomber crew in the pivotal aerial war over Berlin in 1944.

title: M
description: Fritz Lang's classic tells of the Berlin underworld's efforts to capture the loathsome murderer of a child.

title: Hush
description: A deaf woman is stalked by a killer in her home.

title: Phoenix
description: A cop (Ray Liotta) with a big gambling debt gets three buddies involved in a deadly crime to pay off the bookie.

title: The Imposter
description: Filmmaker Bart Layton chronicles the tale of Frederic Bourdin, a con artist who seemingly tricked a Texas family into believing he was a relative who disappeared years earlier.

title: If... Dog... Rabbit
description: When a criminal is released from prison, he promptly returns to a life of crime with his lawbreaking brother.

title: Guardians
description: A team of former Soviet superheroes, assembled during the Cold War to combat a dangerous scientist, is dispatched against destructive robots.
